description: What is in an HSK list: an HSK level (1-6), an HSK 3.0 band (1-6 or 7-9) or a topic (numbers, food and drink, family, ...). Answers with the number of words, the first five with their pinyin and meaning, the list's Talkhao page and its practice link; when the learner's account is connected, each word's state on their trail. Give exactly one of level, band or topic.
